paragraphs.text:
Your swift exit from the meadow proves a wise decision. The 
terrified animals begin to stampede.

Make a CON roll to outdistance the stampede—your rapid response 
gives you a bonus die. If you succeed, go to 361. If not, the animals catch 
you, causing 2D10 damage. If you survive, go to 347. Otherwise, the 
Nadelmann Expedition is over. THE END.
